caption: This drawing depicts a wooden high chair with a reddish-brown hue. The chair has four long, tapered legs that angle outward and are connected by horizontal support bars. The seat is rectangular with rounded edges, and the backrest consists of a curved horizontal slat supported by four vertical spindles. Only the right side of the chair has an armrest, which extends outward and slightly upward, while the left side has none. There is a piece of dark-colored fabric or material, possibly a strap or band, wrapped around the left vertical spindle of the backrest, forming a knot or bow. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the detailed rendering of the chair. The artist’s signature and year appear in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Child's High Chair
